complaint: Hi there, I pay for 500 Mbps fibre but only get about 90. It has been happening for two weeks. It's really disruptive. What are my options?
resolution: Investigated fibre speed stuck at 100 mbps: checking cables and router ports. Replace old Cat5 ethernet cables with Cat5e or Cat6. Confirm the router has gigabit WAN and LAN ports; replace it with the supported fibre router if not. Re-run a wired speed test directly from the ONT or router. Follow-up call next day confirmed the issue is fixed.

complaint: I upgraded to a faster fibre package but my speed tests haven't improved past 100. The ethernet cable is quite old. Please advise. Thanks.
resolution: Caller described fibre speed stuck at 100 mbps: checking cables and router ports. Root cause: A bottleneck in the customer's equipment: a router or ethernet cable limited to 100 Mbps (Fast Ethernet / Cat5). Check the negotiated link speed on the computer's network adapter (100 Mbps vs 1 Gbps). Replace old Cat5 ethernet cables with Cat5e or Cat6. Confirm the router has gigabit WAN and LAN ports; replace it with the supported fibre router if not. Follow-up call next day confirmed the issue is fixed.
